title: When an Entitled Girl Gets Instantly Humbled
description:
An officer was dispatched to a bar to evict a group of people who had been denied service for creating a ruckus in the pool. This is what happened next. The group was taking their sweet time to pack up, and while some were cooperating others felt they were too important to be kicked out. The 23 year old female was charged with disorderly conduct, trespassing, and resisting arrest.
